stem: Why was President Ronald Reagan criticized for the Iran-Contra Affair?

options.label: A
options.text: His administration supported a revolution against an elected leader in Iran.

options.label: B
options.text: His policies involved the sharing of nuclear technology with Iran.

options.label: C
options.text: His policies threatened petroleum trade agreements with Iran.

options.label: D
options.text: His administration violated an embargo by selling weapons to Iran.
